message: the current dungeon stays direct while its complete rules have a deliberate door

copy.starting-fuel-help: Changing the starting lantern begins a new game. Start again keeps this choice. A flask can still refill up to twenty fuel.
copy.passage-help: The low lintel refuses a pack heavier than three. Go through the Well, or lighten the pack. Either arch still falls after the first banked haul.
copy.homeward-step-help: This takes one ordinary road. It does not bank treasure, leave the dungeon or complete the whole return.
copy.gate-route-help: This route keeps your current pack and takes no new items. A carried flask refills only after banking at the gate.
copy.take-return-help: These previews take one item, keep the resulting pack and collect nothing else on the way home. A carried flask refills only at the gate.
copy.exchange-help: Set down one carried item and take this floor item in one choice. No fuel is spent. Undo reverses both parts.
copy.unload-help: Put all carried treasure on this floor in one choice. Keep the flask, if you have it. Nothing is safe at the gate until you bank it.
copy.drop-preview-help: Dropping costs no fuel, but the item stays in this room. The return estimate keeps everything else in your pack.
copy.bank-one-help: Bank one carried item to keep the rest in your pack. The first banked item still closes the short arch. Banking only the flask spends it for fuel.
copy.trip-keep-help: Return restores this whole attempt and its starting lantern. It clears the current Undo steps; it does not spend a road or bank treasure.
